digest.component_or_area: verifier resumption mechanism and search strategy optimization
propositions: Passing prior search frontier as exclusion list to resumption does not reduce re-search overlap rate by >=30% relative to control on test corpus.
Data-shaped frontier block inside untrusted fence is rendered inert by fence design and cannot suppress rational evidence re-grounding during resumption.
Frontier block acts as signpost causing model to immediately re-read files listed as already-searched, increasing measured overlap rather than reducing it.

Cache-seeding mechanism already removes dominant redundancy (re-proving credited criteria); remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be effectively suppressed by exclusion list in untrusted context.
Experiment failed both predeclared acceptance criteria on both tickets: 45c1 showed +78% overlap increase and 8d74 showed +60% increase, both exceeding -30% reduction requirement.
